description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 录屏控制条按住任何空白处（边距、文字、按钮之间的空隙）都能拖，不再只认左端的手柄；截图设置里多了“录屏保存文件夹”，默认是“视频”里的 WinShun，可一键恢复默认。装了增强文字识别的较大模型或自己的模型（Win顺 0.48.0）时，截图识别文字也用它，能读日文。图标按容器排版，间距统一。权限不变。
notes.en: The recording bar moves from any empty place (margins, words, the gaps between buttons), not only its grip; the screenshot settings have a Recording folder row (WinShun in Videos by default, one click back to it). With the larger or your own enhanced OCR model installed (WinShun 0.48.0), recognizing text in a capture uses it and reads Japanese. Icons are laid out by their container, with consistent gaps. Permissions unchanged.
